limitations: Original publication availability and consensus constituent vintages are not certified.
Current watchlist projected backward creates survivorship and selection bias.
All years are retrospective; no genuine out-of-sample result.
Exploratory confidence intervals are unadjusted for multiple testing.
Sector and factor exposures are not neutralized.
Sell-side and curated X archives are selective and retrospectively classified.
Peer groups use current wiki classifications; historical membership and equal fiscal time-to-maturity are not established.
Relative-context confidence intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Twenty-session annual samples are too short for reported intervals; five-session peer results can depend on block length.
Conditional returns are gross associations, without a net trading strategy or risk-factor-neutral attribution.
Raw-indicator Holm16 is within-company only; no cross-company/manual-selection/period correction.
Centered-bootstrap p-values are approximate; propagated Wilson ranges diagnose simulation precision rather than simultaneous statistical confidence.
X observations cover vendor-observed weekdays; counts do not certify complete weekend or all-X coverage.
Rank is absolute historical high-minus-low effect, with direction selected retrospectively; volatility and stock visibility can affect ranking.
No default2026 classification passing all gates is not proof that every effect is zero.

Pooling2024-latest was user-requested after observing2026 results; it increases sample size but creates no untouched validation period. Annual schedule resets/year-end exclusions and52-week rolling reference remain unchanged.
Pairselection uses only2024–2025 computations, but2026 was previously examined and does not constitute an untouched holdout.
Pair netreturn selection may favor market exposure;cash earns zero and10bp-per-side costs are scenarios. Always-active reference and activity are disclosed.
The fixed12 family covers chosen pair vs three benchmarks across axes/horizons within each company, not global96company discoveries; duplicate comparators are not independent evidence.
All-cash resamples remain valid zero increments. Unavailable statistics are not recoded as zero. Twenty-session2026 samples remain at most10holds.
